facts: A novel approach is presented for automatically acquiring English topic signatures.
A topic signature is a set of words that tend to co-occur with a particular concept or word sense.
Topic signatures can be useful in a number of Natural Language Processing applications.
Topic signatures can be useful in Word Sense Disambiguation.
Topic signatures can be useful in Text Summarisation.
A method takes advantage of the different way in which word senses are lexicalised in English and Chinese.
Word senses are lexicalised in a different way in English and Chinese.
A method exploits the large amount of Chinese text available in corpora.
A method exploits the large amount of Chinese text available on the Web.
Topic signatures were evaluated on a WSD task.
A second-order vector cooccurrence algorithm was trained.
A second-order vector cooccurrence algorithm was trained on standard WSD datasets.
The WSD task evaluation yielded promising results.
NLP stands for Natural Language Processing.
WSD stands for Word Sense Disambiguation.
